subject: DEFINE directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.11.4 "is evaluated according to 7.3.6, Compile-time arithmetic expressions" -> OK GR6; --check 7.3.6.3 "shall be truncated to the integer part of the value" -> OK GR3. p1b: '7 + 2 * 3' = 13 (precedence), '7 / 2' = 3 (truncated), '1.5 + 1' evaluates; a name operand (>>DEFINE Q N) resolves the earlier value. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 - §7.3 compiler-directive facility; ISO/IEC 1989:2023 Annex E lists no change to §7.3.11 against 2014 (the 2002 introduction is not stated in the 2023 text itself; below 2002 the directive is COBOL0900)
